none checked — this chunk covers 11 of the ~150 words new at HSK2; I did not audit the remaining official list for entries missing from the project as a whole, only checked the given ids against it.

None of the 11 given entries belong to a different level: all are absent from the official HSK1 (150-word) list and present in the official cumulative HSK（二级）词汇 (300 words), confirming they are genuinely new at HSK2, not carried over from HSK1.

One reading worth flagging as correct-but-easy-to-doubt: h2w035 过 "guo" (experience-aspect particle). The official Nottongham/Hanban HSK2 PDF prints it with a tone mark ("guò") in its 助词 table, but that's inconsistent with every other particle in the same row (的/了/吗/呢/地/得/着/吧, all shown neutral) and with the Xinhua Pinxie Cidian's explicit rule that 动态助词 (aspectual particles, incl. 了/着/过) are always read qīngshēng. Treating the PDF's tone mark there as a transcription artifact rather than the standard; the neutral "guo" already in the draft is correct.
